tools.name: wavepay_register
tools.description: Register a WavePay merchant account. Returns a live merchant key once — save it; only its hash is stored. Free tier: 25 payments per 30 days.

tools.name: wavepay_providers
tools.description: List the payment rails this deployment can take — PayNow (EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari, ZimSwitch, cards) and PayPal.

tools.name: wavepay_pricing
tools.description: Live plans and prices for a product, per rail, with the active promotion.

tools.name: wavepay_checkout
tools.description: Start a checkout for a product/plan on a rail; returns the hosted checkoutUrl to hand the buyer.

tools.name: wavepay_checkout_status
tools.description: Poll a payment by reference: pending | collected | expired.

tools.name: wavepay_catalog
tools.description: Merchant self-service catalog — the sites, plans, prices and coupons your merchant key can see. Requires the x-wavepay-service-key header carrying an mk_live_… or mk_test_… key.
